news.body:
## Tomorrow is the 8th, and only one of the three can wait
- Your KITAS expires and both Google applications close, all on a Sunday.
Nobody at InCorp will confirm anything about the permit tomorrow, so that one really is out of your hands now. The two applications are online forms though, and a Sunday costs them nothing. - An hour each tomorrow still counts.
## Monday needs a folder, and one thing in it does not exist yet
- Your VFS slot is 2:45pm on the 10th and the Campus France call sits forty-five minutes behind it.
Delhi's list is the expense statement, proof of funds, your accommodation booking and the acceptance attestation, plus a printout of the Etudes en France completion mail, which has not arrived. The SBI sanction is dated the 10th as well, so it may not be in your hand by that afternoon. - Sunday is the day to lay the folder out and see what is actually missing.
